For anyone who is wondering why this token is the top GTA6 narrative & looking to get bullish, read this thesis.

Meme tokens are all about catalysts & mindshare. I’m in this token because I believe it will dominate mindshare & have ongoing catalysts for 10 weeks (that we know of). Also the fact that Macca has been one of the largest marketing angles for GTA6.

First, and most importantly. Macca and Friends, the TV show. This is a fictional Adult Swim TV show that you can watch in the game. It has weekly releases & forums say that Rockstar had multiple seasons of the show made by a top animation studio.

That means every week, a new episode drops. The first episode has over 10M views btw. Every week is a chance for CT to realize how important Macca is to GTA6 & modern video game culture. It may not be the first, second or third episode. But it’s inevitable that it will catch and go viral. Pulling mindshare from our space into Macca.

Second, Macca is everywhere & I think it’s clear how important this is for Rockstar marketing. It was featured at an NBA game, in advertisements, it’s on merch (more than the main characters), and even was behind the bar at the GTA6 night Rockstar held.

Don’t believe me? Just search X for “macca”.

So multiple times a week Macca is front and center, generating 10+ million views… The token was deployed first and has a strong presence with top content on X. And lastly, it’s a universally super well liked mascot. 

Look at this gator. Everyone is looking at it and knows it looks good, feels good, and could be a main runner.

The market is down, but this is when you should find gems. 

You find gems by looking where no one else is. You look for fundamentals like 1) the meme, 2) catalysts, 3) community. MACCA has all three…

So whether or not this goes down, it’s pointless. The team is going to stay active, and it takes about 50K of buy pressure to get back to 1M…

Who cares about sellers at these levels? They are a blessing. Big money will flow in. and you will know when it does. 

No matter what you do, grab a bag of Macca, join the community, make some content, and give it to your homies.

This one is for the little guys. Let’s win
